assets.title: Acoustic Guitar and Stand
assets.description: Original low-poly acoustic guitar display on a grounded stand. Hand-shaped waisted body has a real closed soundhole recess; six geometric strings join the bridge and nut. Neck, fingerboard, five frets, headstock and six tuning pegs remain separately editable. Approximately 1.22m overall height including the stand. Visual game asset only, not a functioning instrument simulation.

assets.title: Small Busking Stage Corner
assets.description: Original small performance-corner visual scene on a 4.5x3m base. Two 2m-repeat stage modules support a guitar with stand, a speaker and a microphone stand. Deck top is Z=0.46m, with a 10mm module seam. Source objects remain separately editable. No sound, electrical connection, performance animation, structural rating or event-safety certification is included.

assets.title: Modular Low Stage Platform
assets.description: Original low stage module with four editable deck boards and separate steel-style legs, rails and feet. Nominal X repeat is 2m; actual deck width is 1.99m, leaving a 10mm seam between repeated modules. Depth is 1m and top height 0.37m. Visual asset only, no structural load or event-safety rating is implied.

assets.title: Community Upright Piano
assets.description: Original upright piano with supported tall case, fixed open keyboard cover, 52 notched white keys and 36 raised black keys in the complete A0-C8 sequence, and three connected static pedals. One instrument with 110 editable closed meshes. Self-contained checks validate every keybed contact, key clearance, displaced-key collision negative and rear-foot case connection. Existing floor and adjacent chair are separate reused context. Static visual asset only; no sound, key action, pedal mechanism, ergonomic or load certification.
